title: Using Crunchbase to Find Startups to Work At
description:
Looking to break into tech or land a job at a startup? Enter @crunchbasehq — a searchable platform of companies, their funding, and all the people involved. 

One of the best ways to learn about startups is by tracking their funding. You can use Crunchbase to search startups by funding stage, founders, investors, and much more. In this video, I’ll walk you through the basic steps of how to use Crunchbase and find tech companies and startups! 

Try for yourself at https://www.crunchbase.com.
